data.name: SCP
data.detailed_description:
Experience the thrill of covert operations in this tactical co-op shooter set in the mysterious SCP universe. Team up with friends to execute high-stakes infiltration missions against anomalous threats and rogue factions, blending stealth and strategy with intense firefights. Think, shoot, and survive, and you may just live long enough to see the next mission.

Cooperative Gameplay for 2-16 Players

Team up with friends locally or online to execute a selection of infiltration missions. Coordinate your actions, share intel, and support each other to overcome the deadliest anomalies and enemies.

Dynamic Ops in the SCP Universe

Take on diverse missions like containing anomalies, fighting hostile factions, rescuing civilians, and gathering intel. Each scenario demands strategic teamwork and adaptability, ensuring nonstop variety and heart-stopping action..

Deep Tactical Stealth Mechanics

Utilize cover, shadows, and sound to remain undetected. Plan your approach carefully, whether it's silently dispatching guards or bypassing security systems, to maximize your chances of mission success.

Dynamic Combat System

Engage in devastating firefights with a variety of weapons and gadgets. Use cover, suppressing fire, and tactical positioning to outsmart enemies, including anomalous enemies and weapons with unpredictable behaviors.

Procedurally Augmented Missions and Environments

No two operations are the same. Experience a variety of mission layouts, enemy placements, and environmental hazards that keep gameplay fresh and challenging.

Rich SCP Lore Integration

Immerse yourself in the mysterious SCP universe with authentic lore, documents, and audio logs that deepen the story and provide context for your missions.

Advanced Equipment and Customization

Equip your team with a wide range of tactical gear, weapons, and anomaly containment tools. Customize your loadout to match your playstyle and mission requirements.

Supports Modding and Community Content

Enhance your experience with community-created content, custom maps, and mods, keeping the game fresh every time you play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Six-core Intel or AMD, 3.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 12

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04
  • Processor: Six-core Intel or AMD, 3.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible
